scope: Aggregate advisory-review coverage only; no private source text, media, source identifiers or detailed findings

remaining_limits: Clipped or faint text prevents complete assessment of some attachments.
One binary metadata payload remains unassessed.
Visual inspection does not establish ownership, redistribution rights or publication approval.

notes: The first verification drivers assumed the wrong base for workspace-relative input paths; those assertions failed before any source modification.
A further driver assumed every output had a redaction map; the 13 faithfully retained empty pages correctly omit one.
After inspecting the actual contract, all input/output hashes and both nonempty candidates' exact redaction reconstructions passed.

release_state.meaning: Advisory reading is complete within recorded limits, but no nonempty text or media item is authorized for public release.
release_state.required_next_action: Applicable source/data-owner review and a decision bound to the exact proposed subset and destination; unresolved media also needs a readable source or an explicit exclusion.

limits: Withheld does not mean every word is secret; it means the item has not been cleared for this release.
Empty pages are accounted for, not used to claim that a meaningful wiki was published.
Mechanical redaction and advisory classification do not declassify organizational content.
Source-specific review scripts, inventories, original/candidate text and media remain in authorized local storage.
